service.description: The record of a Chatter or RecordFiles panel, found under the user's filters (mantle.party.CommunicationServices.get#RecordLinkInfo with checkOnly, which answers recordVisible without an error): the link info, its title (a wiki page's first heading, else its name), type label, BOSS screen (ironstone.commons.PaletteServices.get#RecordLink, null when Commons and Comms have none) and icon. A record the user may not see is logged; with requireVisible it is an error (a write is refused), otherwise visible is false (a read answers nothing).

parameter.name: forFiles
parameter.description: For the record's files (RecordFiles): a client contact (the PROJECT_CLIENT permission) sees the files of a request only (impl-projects.md P10)

service.description: The link a notification about the record opens: recordUrl when it is a /qapps screen path (the host page, the current app's record screen, as the panel sends it), else the record's Commons or Comms screen.

actions.script: const text = recordUrl ? String(recordUrl).trim() : '' recordUrl = /^\/qapps\/[A-Za-z0-9_\-\/.]+(\?[^\s<>"'`]*)?$/.test(text) && !text.includes('//') ? text : (fallbackUrl || null)

service.description: The people of the @ mention list, the To of an internal message, the followers to add and the assignee drop-down: active user accounts with a party whose name or username has the term, as {id (the userId), value (the same), label, partyId}.

actions.script: userList = Array.from(accountList).map((account) => ({id: account.userId, value: account.userId, label: account.userFullName || account.username, partyId: account.partyId}))

service.description: The user accounts of a list (or comma-separated text) of userIds that exist, with their parties; for the mentions of a rich-text body (data-mention-id) and the users chosen in a drop-down.

parameter.name: html
parameter.description: Rich text whose data-mention-id spans add userIds

service.description: The panel apart from its timeline: the record (title, type, screen, icon, whether it has files), the user, what the user may do (message and note, schedule, update the record), the followers with the kinds they get and the user's own, the planned activities soonest first (type, summary, due with overdue, assignee, whether the user may change it), the first files for the attachments strip, and the record's parties with an email address for "Email…". Each part stands alone: one that fails is logged and named in failedSources. Nothing but visible false for a record the user may not see.

parameter.name: forClient
parameter.description: A client contact (impl-projects.md P10b): the panel offers Send message to the team and Reply only, no followers, notes, activities or Email

service.description: Which of the parties have a face image (PartyContent PcntFaceImage), so the panel asks the avatar transition only for those; the transition checks the party again (ironstone.commons.ContactServices.get#ContactAvatar).
HTML as an allow-html="safe" parameter keeps it (the framework's ammonia list plus data-mention-id): the body of a message or note before the panel shows it.

A page of the record's timeline (mantle.party.CommunicationServices.get#RecordTimeline) as the panel shows it, newest first: each entry's key, kind, icon and color, the author's name, what it is (Email, Message, Note, Call done, a change, a file), when (dateText, and dateMillis), its title, its body as safe HTML with quoted text apart (quotedHtml, collapsed in the panel), the delivery status of an email, its attachments, the thread's Inbox link, and which actions apply (reply here, reply by email, unlink, and for a note edit, for its author, with its text as editBody, and delete, for its author or the ADMIN group while it has no replies), and whether a note was edited (edited, editedText); a message of the record's chat room links to it in Comms Chat. kinds is all, messages, notes, activities, changes or files. The next page is asked with beforeDate and seenKeys, the nextBeforeDate and nextSeenKeys of this one (get#RecordTimeline's cursor, which neither skips nor repeats entries of the same date).

parameter.name: beforeDate
parameter.description: Epoch millis: the nextBeforeDate of the page before

parameter.name: seenKeys
parameter.description: The nextSeenKeys of the page before, comma separated (or a list)

parameter.name: nextBeforeDate
parameter.description: The beforeDate of the next page (epoch millis): the date of the last entry of this page, shown or not

parameter.name: nextSeenKeys
parameter.description: The seenKeys of the next page: the entries of this page and the ones before it whose date is nextBeforeDate

service.description: Log note: a Comment on the record (mantle.party.CommunicationServices.log#RecordNote), rich text whose @ mentions (data-mention-id, a userId) are notified on topic ChatterMention, the followers of notes on RecordFollow; the notifications link to recordUrl, the host page (the current app's record screen).

service-call.name: mantle.party.CommunicationServices.log#RecordNote

set.from: mentionedUserIds?.length ? ec.resource.expand('Note logged; ${count} mentioned', '', {count:mentionedUserIds.length}) : ec.l10n.localize('Note logged')

service.description: Send message, internal: a Message from the user to the users chosen (toUserIds; the @ mentions of the body are added as cc and notified on ChatterMention) through mantle.party.CommunicationServices.create#Message, filed on the record (link#CommunicationEventRecord, which notifies the followers of messages). Email to the record's parties goes through Comms Compose (M5, mantle.party.CommunicationServices.send#EmailDraft).

return.message: A confidential case's conversation is its notes: write a note for its people
Choose who to send the message to

service.description: Whether a communication event is on the record: for a party, from or to it or one of its party rows; for another record, the event or its thread's first message through the record's own join or a CommunicationEventRecord. An error when it is not.

Reply in the timeline to an internal message or a note on the record (mantle.party.CommunicationServices.reply#CommunicationEvent: a Message answers its thread's participants, a Comment the parent's other party), filed on the record too; its @ mentions are notified.

service-call.name: mantle.party.CommunicationServices.reply#CommunicationEvent

return.message: You may not take this message off ${recordOut.typeLabel} ${recordOut.title}

set.from: unlinked ? ec.resource.expand('Taken off ${recordName}', '', {recordName:recordOut.title}) : ec.l10n.localize('It stays: the record is its sender or a recipient, or it is in a thread filed here')

service.description: Edit a note in the timeline: its author changes the text of a note or comment on the record (mantle.party.CommunicationServices.update#RecordNote, which checks it is the author's and on this record, marks it edited, and notifies only the users mentioned now and not before: data-mention-id userIds of the rich text).

return.message: Write the note first, or delete it

set.from: mentionedUserIds.length ? ec.resource.expand('Note changed; ${count} newly mentioned', '', {count:mentionedUserIds.length}) : ec.l10n.localize('Note changed')

service.description: Delete a note in the timeline: its author, or a user in the ADMIN group, deletes a note or comment on the record that has no replies (mantle.party.CommunicationServices.delete#RecordNote, which checks both; its links and attachments go too).
An attachment of a message or note on the record (a CommunicationEventContent of an event on the record): its location, file name, and whether it may show inline (a raster image or a PDF).

Schedule activity: a call, email or to-do (a task) or a meeting (an event) on the record, assigned to assignToPartyId (default the user), through ironstone.commons.QuickCreateServices.create#Activity (the record's own join or a WorkEffortRecord; its followers of activities notified).

service-call.name: ironstone.commons.QuickCreateServices.create#Activity

service.description: An activity the user may change from the record's Chatter: a work effort on the record (its own join or a WorkEffortRecord) of which the user's party is the owner or a current assignee. An error otherwise.

Mark done (the MarkDone dialog): the activity to WeComplete (mantle.work.TaskServices.update#Task); the feedback becomes a Comment on the record (log#Note, its mentions notified); with a next activity (type, summary, due) it is scheduled the same way.

return.message: The next activity needs a summary and a due date

service-call.name: ironstone.shared.ChatterServices.log#Note

set.from: ec.resource.expand(nextWorkEffortId ? 'Done: ${name}; the next activity is scheduled' : 'Done: ${name}', '', {name:activityName})

service.description: Edit a planned activity: its summary, due (a meeting's start and end), note and assignee (mantle.work.TaskServices.update#Task; the assignee through mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.replace#WorkEffortParty).
Cancel a planned activity (WeCancelled through mantle.work.TaskServices.update#Task); it leaves the planned list and the timeline.
The user follows the record (mantle.party.CommunicationServices.follow#Record), with the kinds given (messages, notes, activities, changes) or, new, messages, notes and activities.

set.from: kinds == null || kinds === '' ? null : (Array.isArray(kinds) ? kinds : String(kinds).split(','))
kindList ? ec.l10n.localize('Your notifications for this record are saved') : ec.resource.expand('You follow ${recordName}', '', {recordName:recordOut.title})

service.description: The user stops following the record, or another follower is removed (userId): by that follower, or a user the record's authorization lets update the record.

return.message: You may not remove followers of ${recordOut.title}

set.from: followerUserId == ec.user.userId ? ec.resource.expand('You no longer follow ${recordName}', '', {recordName:recordOut.title}) : ec.l10n.localize('Follower removed')

service.description: Add followers: each user chosen follows the record (messages, notes and activities); one that fails is logged and the others are added.

The card of a record for m-record-card (docs/ui/Qvt-Client.md, Record cards): {title, typeLabel, icon, id, entity, url, status {label, color}, fields}, from mantle.GeneralServices.lookup#ById and the record's BOSS screen (ironstone.commons.PaletteServices.get#RecordLink), under the user's filters. A record the user may not see answers only its id.
